source: OpenAI press release: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Uber: Uber announced the company-wide rollout of ChatGPT Work, an agent within ChatGPT Enterprise, making it available to more than 30,000 employees across Uber's global workforce, expanding from an initial pilot of 1,000 employees; GPT-6.1 Sol will be the default model within ChatGPT Work, and Uber's developers will continue using Codex. President and co-founder Greg Brockman: 'bringing ChatGPT Work to tens of thousand employees is a big step toward expanding access to frontier AI capabilities and tools.'
